newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News' Australian papers lift profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News' Australian papers lift profit.

text.p: Global media group News Corp Ltd said on Thursday that its Australian newspaper operations achieved a slight year-on-year rise in first half profits based on improved results in the December quarter.

"Advertising volumes continued to be below last year with the national and retail display and real estate categories reflecting a slow economy," the company said in a statement accompanying its profit result.
"Circulation volumes for week day publications were generally level with last year, while all Sunday newspapers reported circulation gains," it said.
The company did not specify the profit performance of the Australian newspaper operations, which dominate the market in terms of circulation.
Its publications include the nationwide Australian newspaper, the Sydney-based Telegraph-Mirror and Melbourne's Herald-Sun as well as key mastheads in the other four capital cities.
News Corp, which also owns half of regional airline Ansett Australia, said its total operating income from Australasia was flat at A$49 million in the latest six months.
